newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Audiofina H1 1996 profit rises sharply.
newsitem.headline: Audiofina H1 1996 profit rises sharply.

text.p: Six months to June 30, 1996 (in billions of Luxembourg francs unless stated)
NOTE - Audiofina is a Luxembourg-based media holding company. Its main asset is a 96.2 percent stake in Luxembourg-based media group Cie. Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion SA (CLT).
* Audiofina carried out a 10-for-1 stock split last year.

In a statement, Audiofina said its plan to merge CLT with the Ufa television unit of Germany's Bertelsmann should take effect, subject to approval by various anti-trust authorities, at the beginning of 1997.
As a result of the merger, Audiofina said its share in CLT will fall to 49 percent and it should book a "very substantial capital gain".
Audiofina is controlled indirectly by Belgium's Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA.
